title: Hermes Platform Allowlist
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 platform allowlists. Delivery is blocked without explicit allowlist and allowlist is subject-scoped.

allowlist_id.description: Unique identifier for this allowlist entry.

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the allowlist entry.

enabled.description: Whether this platform is enabled for delivery.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when allowlist entry was created.

expires_at.description: Optional. ISO 8601 timestamp when allowlist entry expires.

last_modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when allowlist entry was last modified.

audit_event_on_change.description: Whether allowlist changes create audit events.

default_deny.description: If true, delivery is blocked without explicit allowlist entry.
